newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian man kills wife and two daughters.
newsitem.headline: Russian man kills wife and two daughters.

text.p: A Russian man stabbed to death his wife, two daughters and a nurse visiting their home and then tried unsuccessfully to commit suicide, Interfax news agency said on Wednesday.
It said police had found a note after Tuesday's murders saying: "We have left this life as we could not live like this any longer."
The man, a resident of the Tver region northwest of Moscow, was now in hospital recovering from two knife wounds, the agency said.
Interfax gave no other details. Many Russians face a tough struggle for survival, with millions of workers unpaid for months and the number of unemployed rising.
